Read 2026-10-06T14:08Z.

Why `Clause-②: yes`: the booleans can reuse the existing `yes` / `no` keys in every pack. The greeting's joiners (the comma before the name and the closing period, which zh-CN writes `，` and `。`) need a translation key. Adding one to the exported `en` pack widens `@object-ui/i18n`'s `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`), so the at-tier contract review runs before enqueue. If the dev lands the joiners without a new key (an existing key, or an existing locale-aware formatter), it reports the built-declaration reading, and the seat amends this line to `no` before any review.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11731 at `550037f` (`Fixes #11689`). An at-tier contract review is owed before enqueue

`domain:ui` execution seat 2 · `session_01FngvPpdrnhHMdHHq6vwwju` (`os-justin`) · 2026-10-06T16:24Z. Dev report: `os-dev-report` `6020609294` on this card. Claim `6018076719`, amended by `6019561490`.

- **Shape:**
  - The PR is a draft on base `main` (merge-base `a58626c`). Its first line is `Fixes #11689`, and `Clause-②: yes` starts a line.
  - It has 25 files, +799/−16, of which non-test, non-changeset source is +220/−16.
  - `git merge-tree` against `main` at `834c559` is clean. NOT GOVERNED.
  - The assignee is `os-justin`; the dev's assignee write went through this time.
  - The commits: `e225ebe`, `c151970` and `c11308a` (the round's first stroke), `0c09bd7` (merges `main` at `a58626c`, which carries objectui#11721, as a merge commit), then `07af6e5` and `550037f` (the amendment's family sites).
- **Surface amendment, recorded here.** These are past the amended claim, and the seat accepts each one:
  - **`packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx` and its new test.** The dev measured the card's actual sighting (`sys_user` `email_verified`, a highlight field) in the record-detail highlights chip, which spelled `Yes` / `No` as JSX text. Fixing the producer is inside the order. The chip now reads the same word as the form.
  - **`ObjectGrid.tsx`'s generated-columns path** (about `:4065`). This is the fourth site of the amendment's one-line label handoff: the header is computed once, and the face is handed it. It is still a label swap. All four `header` bindings are in scope where they are used (`:3464`, `:3728`, `:3927`, `:4065`).
  - **`packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.cellFaces-11686.test.tsx`.** Seat 1's zh pin keeps every assertion and gains one: the whole badge reads `启用 — 已关闭`. The amendment foresaw this re-judge once objectui#11721 landed first.
- **Seat's own reading of the diff:**
  - `useBooleanValueLabel()` (new, `widgets/booleanValueLabel.tsx`) returns `t(value ? 'common.yes' : 'common.no')` through `useFieldTranslation`. `FIELD_DEFAULTS` gains `common.yes` / `common.no` with the en values, so a render with no provider still says what the literals said.
  - `BooleanField` (readonly), `FormulaField` (`returnType: 'boolean'`) and the lookup column's plain-text fallback read it. The fallback returns a `BooleanValueText` node rather than a string, because it cannot call the hook and both of its callers render what it returns.
  - `BooleanCellRenderer`'s three words are now `fields.boolean.offBadge` (`{{label}} — Off`), `fields.boolean.completed` and `fields.boolean.notCompleted`, with `useFieldTranslation` called before the early return.
  - The grid hands the face the label its header prints, on all four column paths. A field with no authored label still gets the face's own fallback.
  - The Home greeting's joiners are `home.greetingSeparator` and `home.greetingEnd`, with en defaults `', '` and `'.'`. The separator is drawn only when there is a name. zh uses the full-width `，` and `。`, and ja and ar their own marks.
- **Clause-②: yes, confirmed by measurement.** The dev diffed the built `dist/locales/en.d.ts` from base `c910630` to head `550037f`: it gains `fields.boolean{offBadge,completed,notCompleted}`, `home.greetingSeparator` and `home.greetingEnd`, and nothing else moves. The `@object-ui/fields` entry gains `useBooleanValueLabel` and `type BooleanValueLabel`. `BooleanValueText` is not exported from the entry.
- **Changeset:** `minor` for `@object-ui/fields`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid`, `app-shell` and `i18n`. Its "Widened public surface" paragraph names exactly the five keys and the new export. The seat read the three behaviour bullets against the diff; this read is the one the contract review re-judges.
- **The changeset-claim re-read (`6020550278`):** `.changeset/11659-console-record-ux.md` says `RecoveryPasswordReminder` moved out of `HomePage.tsx`. This PR changes only the greeting's two joiners there, so that paragraph stays true.
- **Tests and gates (dev, measured at `550037f`):**
  - Type-check and lint across the six packages, 0 errors.
  - vitest: `packages/fields/` 3683 tests; `plugin-detail` + `i18n` 3698; `plugin-grid` + `plugin-tree` 1905; the 5 root i18n suites 331; a narrowed `app-shell` set of 23 files, 202 tests. All green.
  - The i18n keys, drift, dead-keys and designer-parity gates, and the changeset and line gates: all exit 0.
  - Four ablation legs went red exactly as predicted: 7, 1, 6 and 1 red. Each was restored by blob and proved with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- **Out-of-scope findings (6), Acceptance note, not filed:** none cites a contract or names a public door, and all are in the dev report.
  - English boolean words remain in the gantt tooltip, the designer `PropertyEditor` and `deriveMasterDetail` options.
  - The highlight chip and `FormulaField` decide by truthiness, so a null value draws `No`.
  - The ko pack has two spellings, `아니오` and `아니요`.
  - The inline-data header uses the authored label.
  - A generated-columns def with no `name` gets no status badge.
  - `auditHistoryDisplay.formatScalar` keeps its own selection.
- **CI on `550037f`:** in progress at this read (26 success, 3 skipped, 13 running, 0 failed). The PR is `behind` `main`, with a clean merge, and the merge queue builds the group.
- **Owed before enqueue:** an at-tier contract review on `550037f`. `needs:contract-review` is hung on the PR in this stroke.
